reason: My nights fill through my PR people, the WhatsApp lists and the regulars, and a lot of my crowd are students who won't be hunting for flyers on a new app. The free listing costs me nothing, but I wouldn't pay for anything until I see real people using it.
objection: My competitors will be on it too, so what do I gain? A pushed night for 39 euro doesn't beat my PR and my lists, and an app with no audience yet is just a promise.
would_change_my_mind: Published proof of thousands of real monthly users in my city, many of them students, and ticket sales or a feature that brings people my PR and lists don't already reach.
